name: che-keychain
description: Trust-isolated macOS keychain credential prompt. Native NSAlert renders inside a signed binary's own process — caller (LLM / MCP / script) never sees the typed value. 0.4.0: set --replace (explicit, backed-up replacement of foreign / allow-all items with a recovery rehearsal before any dialog), has --non-empty, set-pair consent parity. Wrapper auto-downloads the signed CheKeychain binary from the PsychQuant/che-keychain GitHub Release to ~/bin/che-keychain so consumers find it via PATH.
